"""Create auditable metrics from completed local runner/HTTP/UI records."""
import collections
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
base = root / "traces/implementation-validation"
runs = sys.argv[1:]
summary = {"runs": [], "outcomes": {}, "official_result": "not_available"}
fingerprints = []
for name in runs:
    folder = base / name
    report = json.loads((folder / "selftest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    network = [json.loads(line) for line in (folder / "webdav-requests.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
    ui = [json.loads(line) for line in (folder / "ui-events.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
    requests = {row["request_id"]: row for row in network if row["event"] == "request"}
    responses = {row["request_id"]: row for row in network if row["event"] == "response"}
    overlaps = []
    for row in ui:
        if row["event"] != "ui_loading_sample":
            continue
        matching = [request_id for request_id in row["active_request_ids"]
                    if requests[request_id]["epoch"] <= row["epoch"] <= responses[request_id]["epoch"]
                    and requests[request_id]["auth_matches_fixture"]
                    and requests[request_id]["root"] == row["root"]]
        assert matching, f"Non-overlapping loading sample in {name}: {row}"
        overlaps.append({"test": row["test"], "epoch": row["epoch"], "root": row["root"],
                         "request_ids": matching})
    durations = {request_id: responses[request_id]["epoch"] - request["epoch"]
                 for request_id, request in requests.items() if request_id in responses}
    terminals = [row for row in ui if row["event"] == "sync_terminal"]
    counts = collections.Counter(case["outcome"] for case in report["cases"])
    for case in report["cases"]:
        summary["outcomes"][case["name"]] = case["outcome"]
    for path in sorted(folder.glob("source-fingerprint-*.json")):
        content = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        fingerprints.append(content)
    summary["runs"].append({"run": name, "report": str(folder.relative_to(root) / "selftest.json"),
                            "runner_exit": int((folder / "selftest-exit.txt").read_text().strip()),
                            "counts": dict(counts), "environment_warnings": report["env_warnings"],
                            "requests": len(requests), "responses": len(responses),
                            "methods": dict(collections.Counter(row["method"] for row in requests.values())),
                            "max_request_seconds": max(durations.values(), default=0),
                            "loading_network_overlaps": overlaps, "terminals": terminals,
                            "long_chains": [row for row in ui if row["event"] == "long_chain_complete"]})
assert fingerprints and all(item == fingerprints[0] for item in fingerprints), "Frozen production fingerprints differ"
summary["source_integrity"] = {"all_fingerprints_equal": True, "files": len(fingerprints[0]),
                               "manifest_sha256": hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(fingerprints[0], sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()}
(base / "round02-validation-summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"runs": [{key: row[key] for key in ("run", "counts", "requests", "responses", "max_request_seconds")}
                            for row in summary["runs"]], "source_integrity": summary["source_integrity"]}, indent=2))

"""Place final valid reports and explicit historical references under logs/."""
import collections
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
traces = root / "traces/implementation-validation"
logs = root / "logs"
logs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
runs = sys.argv[1:]
merged = {}
reports = []
install_sections = []
selftest_sections = []
for name in runs:
    folder = traces / name
    report = json.loads((folder / "selftest.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    for case in report["cases"]:
        merged[case["name"]] = {**case, "evidence_run": name,
                                "raw_report": (folder / "selftest.json").relative_to(root).as_posix()}
    reports.append({"run": name, "runner_exit": int((folder / "selftest-exit.txt").read_text().strip()),
                    "report": (folder / "selftest.json").relative_to(root).as_posix(),
                    "raw_log": (folder / "selftest-raw.log").relative_to(root).as_posix()})
    command = (folder / "Run-command.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    start = command.index("COMMAND: hdc ")
    end = command.index("COMMAND: D:/HCUP/common/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m harness.runner")
    install_sections.append(f"RUN {name}\nSOURCE {folder.relative_to(root)}/Run-command.log\n" + command[start:end])
    selftest_sections.append(f"RUN {name}\nSOURCE {folder.relative_to(root)}/selftest-raw.log\n" +
                             (folder / "selftest-raw.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
valid_cases = [merged[name] for name in sorted(merged)]
out = {"project": str(root), "device_sn": "127.0.0.1:5555", "cases": valid_cases,
       "counts": dict(collections.Counter(case["outcome"] for case in valid_cases)),
       "raw_runs": reports,
       "failure_history": [{"run": "round02-t1", "classification": "test harness lowercase swipe direction before sync click",
                            "report": "traces/implementation-validation/round02-t1/selftest.json"}],
       "official_result": "not_available"}
(logs / "build.log").write_bytes((traces / "round02-t1/build-raw.log").read_bytes())
(logs / "install.log").write_text("\n\n".join(install_sections), encoding="utf-8")
(logs / "selftest.log").write_text("\n\n".join(selftest_sections), encoding="utf-8")
(logs / "selftest.json").write_text(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
manifest = {file.name: hashlib.sha256(file.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            for file in (logs / "build.log", logs / "install.log", logs / "selftest.log", logs / "selftest.json")}
(logs / "verification-log-manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"counts": out["counts"], "raw_runs": reports, "log_manifest": manifest}, indent=2))

"""Record historical/current local test versions without changing production."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
base = root / "traces/implementation-validation"
current_fixture = (root / "hypium_tests/webdav_fixture.py").read_bytes()
new_gate = b"scenario.release.wait(timeout=min(16, max(0, 18 - scenario.delay)))"
old_gate = b"scenario.release.wait(timeout=16)"
assert current_fixture.count(new_gate) == 1
historical_fixture = current_fixture.replace(new_gate, old_gate)
for name in ("round02-t1-retry", "round02-regression"):
    (base / name / "fixture-source-used.py").write_bytes(historical_fixture)
manifest = {"historical_fixture": {"sha256": hashlib.sha256(historical_fixture).hexdigest(),
                                   "source": "fixture-source-used.py under the historical run folders",
                                   "reconstruction": "Exact prior fixture text reconstructed from the single recorded gate-limit edit; no runtime monkeypatch."},
            "current_fixture": {"sha256": hashlib.sha256(current_fixture).hexdigest(),
                                "change": "Gate timeout min(16, max(0,18-delay)); combined gate+delay <=18s."},
            "historical_test": {"sha256": hashlib.sha256((base / "round02-regression/test-source-used.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest()},
            "current_test": {"sha256": hashlib.sha256((root / "hypium_tests/test_webdav_loading.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest()}}
(base / "round02-test-versions.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
